messages:
ellie_support: Hey team — customer BlueBox seeing repeated 429s during a nightly fanout yesterday. Spike window ~ 2026-03-15 09:12:30–09:13:10 UTC. They reported ~12k req/min for ~40s from ~50 workers. Can SRE confirm whether this hit the RPM cap or a per-second throttle?

bluebox_ops: yep, our cron fires at 09:12:30 UTC. We rolled out a bigger worker pool yesterday which might've amplified it. We're seeing a hard wall of 429s, not timeouts.

sre_jamie: Pulling ingress + limiter logs now. Quick read: looks like per-minute token exhaustion (customer tier = standard). Our limiter shows usage >> allocated tokens in that minute. Sharing debug snippet.

sre_jamie: ```
limiter.dump customer=bluebox region=us-east-1 window=60s configured_tokens=5000 tokens_used=11890 burst_allowance=1000 policy=leaky_bucket
```

eng_kyle: That matches: 12k/min > 5k/min configured. Token bucket will allow short sub-second bursts but sustained minutes-overage yields 429s. Their pattern is a tight fanout at the minute boundary so bursts align with the window.

dev_blake: Note we also enforce per-route TPM and per-account RPM. If many workers do parallel short requests, you can hit both. We should advise the customer on client-side smoothing + backoff.

ellie_support: @bluebox_ops can you try a quick stagger for a canary? Example: in your cron loop add a randomized sleep between workers (sleep $((RANDOM % 30))). Also implement simple exponential backoff with jitter on 429s.

bluebox_ops: can do. Also, is there a quick temporary bump you can apply while we remediate? We're on the standard plan and need to test before upgrading.

sre_jamie: For testing we can temporarily raise the per-minute allowance. I can open an ops ticket and apply a 1-hour bump to 15k/min for verification. For a permanent increase we'd route through billing.

rate_limiter_bot: Incident: rate-limit-hit | customer=bluebox | region=us-east-1 | window=09:12:30-09:13:15 | 429_count=3245

bluebox_ops: Starting canary now: adding 30s stagger + jitter on retries. Will report logs.

ellie_support: If possible capture request_ids and hit our trace endpoint so we can map the failures: ```curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/trace?req_id=<REQ_ID>'``` — send a couple of req_ids here.

bluebox_ops: canary live — early numbers: 429s dropped from ~3200 to ~20 during the spike window, but still seeing a handful concentrated in the first 5s of the minute.

eng_kyle: That residual cluster at t+0 is classic minute-boundary alignment. Two pragmatic paths: 1) smooth client traffic (best immediate fix), 2) infra change to a rolling/slot-based limiter (higher engineering cost). For now continue smoothing + temporary bump.

sre_jamie: Ops ticket created (#OPS-8242). Applied a temporary increase to 15k/min for 1 hour starting 09:45 UTC for BlueBox. It will auto-revert at 10:45 unless extended.

ellie_support: Great — @bluebox_ops do the 1h test and share a couple of trace req_ids. We'll follow up with permanent recommendations (staggering patterns, backed-off retries, and if needed a billing plan upgrade).

bluebox_ops: Will do — kicking off tests now. Big thanks for the fast turn. :pray:
